_documentation.file: Copied to agents.local.json on startup only when missing. The local file is ignored by Git and never sent to the browser.
_documentation.connection: Optional fields: base_url, api_key, editor_model, reviewer_model, reasoning_effort (none, low, medium, high), vision, vision_image_divisor (1-64, default 4), max_reviews (1-10), max_output_tokens (512-32768), timeout_ms (1000-600000). Empty connection uses localhost:1234, model discovery and vision. AGENT_* environment variables override their documented connection fields.
_documentation.agents: Each role supports model and instructions. Empty model inherits editor_model or discovered model; reviewer inherits reviewer_model or the default editor. Instructions extend the role's built-in instructions. Keep private prompts and credentials in this local file.
_documentation.layers: Workflows 1-7 count total stages. 1: artist without review. 2: artist plus editable quality pass, without a separate reviewer. 3-7: two to six creation stages plus reviewer.
